scope: 钱款分摊与小额往来较长说法
author: continuous-lexicon-author
review_scope: One AI author reads every selected expression and full-pinyin key in context, then records positional character choices. Structural reconstruction is not an independent linguistic editor. Individually authored common vocabulary; no third-party lexicon or test-derived words.
pronunciation_dependency: pypinyin 0.55.0 authoring-only; contextual choices selected by author
frequency_policy: Coarse project-relative editorial weights 6000/5500/5000; capped by the lowest existing homophone band >=5000. No imported frequency statistics.
